shots.name: Want to SHUT DOWN perimeter shooters? O2 catches, X3 closes out, no shot
This is how the 3-2 zone works: rewind to the base shape, areas + markers, title
Three up top, two down low, control the wings
Ball to the wing: X3 closes out, EVERYONE shifts (X1 elbow, X2 middle, X5 block, X4 rim)
Corner rotation: X5 steps out, X4 slides across, X3 cuts off, X1 high post, X2 weak block
High-post threat: O5 flashes, entry, X1 reacts, the zone changes shape
Great at contesting perimeter shots: X2 contests O3's three
But: corners, high post, rebounding (freeze, amber areas in turn)
Find a body. Box out: X2-O3, X1-O1, X3-O2, X4-O5, X5-O4
Five defenders. One connected unit. Follow for more European basketball.

A.title: 3-2 zone (A): ball to the right wing (all five shift), then the right corner (X5 out, X4 across, X3 cuts off, X1 high post, X2 weak block)
